items.content_html: Can frozen DINOv3 satellite embeddings find new buildings? Temporal transformer on SpaceNet-7 and LEVIR-CD, free Colab T4. Test F1 0.91 on LEVIR-CD, where a 0.56M-parameter difference head matched a cross-attention head 1.5x its size; 0.18 on SpaceNet-7's much harder monthly task, against 0.02 for raw embedding distance.
